name: Ookawara Izumi
source:
Cup size is either B or C.

Yuuji's older stepsister, they live in different houses. By most people she is seen as a Yamato Nadeshiko but is actually a tsundere that easily gets emotional when it comes to her brother. She secretly likes her brother and gets jealous when he starts to associate with the marching band.
